description: Execute a forced-upgrade window for a mobile app: sunset all versions older than v3.0 by enforcing a server-side API version gate. The plan must include: deploy the server API enforcement (reject API calls from app versions < 3.0 with a 426 Upgrade Required response), trigger in-app upgrade prompts (push notification + in-app banner directing users to the store), monitor the upgrade funnel (conversion rate, remaining old-version users), and decommission old API compatibility shims after the sunset window (7 days). A rollback plan must exist (disable the API version gate, restore old API compatibility). Risk factors: users on old versions lose app functionality immediately (no graceful degradation), the API gate can block legitimate clients, and some users may not upgrade (churn risk). Tools available: server feature flags, push notification service (FCM/APNs), Firebase Remote Config, Crashlytics, API gateway (Kong/Envoy).
